title: The Silent Realm
description: The Silent One is tormented by its own wrongdoings... Can you help it find peace?
body:
## **The Silent One is tormented by its own wrongdoings... Can you help it find peace?**

**The Silent realm is a mod based around the Ancient City, Sculk, and the Warden. To get to the main feature of this mod - The Silent Realm - you must obtain Essence of the Warden and use it to ignite the portal structure at the middle of an Ancient City.**

**Dimensions:**
- The Silent Realm

**Blocks:**
- Hardened Sculk
- Echo Vortex
- Shroud (Water-like fluid)

**Items:**
- Essence of the Warden

**Structures:**
- Summoner
- Hushed Portal

**Biomes:**
- Sculk Fields
- Ancient Forest
